alert.summary: Service identity had 38 failed logins then a success from an unfamiliar external address; unusual archive read followed.
Office child process launched encoded PowerShell, contacted a newly observed external host, then attempted to disable endpoint protection.
Large outbound transfer of finance documents to an external destination outside the user's normal hours.
New autorun entry appeared immediately after an unsigned binary was executed from a temporary directory.
Successful MFA push followed by privileged role assignment and access to several unrelated mailboxes from a new region.
Six failed logins across two regions; no success or follow-on activity recorded.
Endpoint queried a newly registered domain once; no connection or process evidence is available.
Service account requested an elevated role outside the approved maintenance window; change was blocked.
One outbound connection to a rare destination was seen. Threat feed has no match and business context is missing.
A script interpreter enumerated local directories. No network activity, persistence, or sensitive file access was observed.
Two failed logins followed by a successful login from the user's usual region and managed device; normal work session followed.
Signed operating system updater downloaded a package from the organization's documented update service during its maintenance window.
Scheduled backup job accessed the approved archive path and completed within its historical time and volume range.
Managed browser resolved the company's documented status page domain and opened a TLS session.
Developer ran a signed compiler from the approved workspace; hash, parent process, and outbound package registry match the team's baseline.
